description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {1}{U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Voracious Reader trigger.
Resolve the Voracious Reader trigger, causing it to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {1}{U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Voracious Reader trigger.
Resolve the Voracious Reader trigger, causing it to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
